# Bhavya Arora

> Portfolio of Bhavya Arora — performance marketer and Growth Executive at iOTA. Paid acquisition across Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads, with a background in SEO, websites, content, social media, email and research.

The site presents Bhavya's work, how that experience developed, and a personal introduction. Case studies describe the work done for each client and only report results that are evidenced on the page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://your-domain.tld/): Bhavya Arora — performance marketer planning, launching and optimizing paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads for B2B, B2C and D2C brands.
- [Work](https://your-domain.tld/work): Selected work by Bhavya Arora — MUVIQ, Kyra Clinic, Blossom Wellness and ALPYRAMID — across performance marketing, growth, SEO, websites and brand launches.
- [Experience](https://your-domain.tld/experience): How Bhavya Arora’s digital marketing work evolved — from SEO and websites to content, social, strategy, performance marketing and client work, across Digiknowhow, Kyra Clinic and iOTA.
- [About](https://your-domain.tld/about): About Bhavya Arora — a performance marketer and growth executive who works where strategy, execution and performance meet.
- [Contact](https://your-domain.tld/contact): Contact Bhavya Arora by email, phone or LinkedIn, or send a short message about performance marketing, growth or digital work.

## Case studies

- [MUVIQ](https://your-domain.tld/case-studies/muviq): MUVIQ case study — global B2B automotive positioning and lead generation across India and Brazil: 0 to 18 leads month on month, by Bhavya Arora.
- [Kyra Clinic](https://your-domain.tld/case-studies/kyra-clinic): Kyra Clinic case study — local SEO and search visibility for a plastic and aesthetic surgery clinic across Ludhiana, Chandigarh and Punjab, with YouTube and Instagram growth, by Bhavya Arora.
- [Blossom Wellness](https://your-domain.tld/case-studies/blossom-wellness): Blossom Wellness case study — one client, two businesses at different stages: structuring the digital journey for an established counseling practice and building the foundation for a new learning business, by Bhavya Arora.
- [ALPYRAMID](https://your-domain.tld/case-studies/alpyramid): ALPYRAMID case study — turning an art and lifestyle brand idea into a launch-ready Shopify store: storefront, product experience, content and SEO, customer journey, WhatsApp and email foundation, by Bhavya Arora.
